title: Diameter-free reverse inequalities and superorthogonality
summary: We prove three results as part of the program of diameter-free estimates initiated in [CDW26]. The first two are reverse square function estimates for the light cone in $\mathbb{R}^3$. We first establish an abstract $L^4$ inequality of independent interest, under an ordered superorthogonality hypothesis: for every four distinct indices, only the two nonalternating pairings are required to vanish. The loss is $C(1+\log N)^2$, where $N$ is the number of functions. An alternating-determinant argument verifies this hypothesis for separated cone sectors. This gives a diameter-free estimate for…
